elements.name: casting-slate-week-law
elements.text: Takes one studio week. Weekly payroll and studio overhead continue; availability and greenlight affordability are re-checked afterward.

elements.name: casting-compare-header

elements.name: casting-market-price-comparison

elements.name: casting-greenlight-review-body
elements.text: The full Greenlight review — spend confirmation and the commit itself — arrives in the next wave. Your package draft is saved exactly as you left it.

elements.name: casting-review-evidence-line
elements.text: Camera tests add evidence. They did not select the cast.

elements.name: casting-review-changed-body
elements.text: Each read now carries an observed estimate and range from the camera session — evidence that did not exist before. The tests assigned no role and changed no one's availability. Use the evidence alongside Fit, Star Power, availability, and cost.
